circuit.name: merkle16
circuit.statement: public root, nullifierHash, context; private nullifier, trapdoor, 16 siblings and index bits; nullifierHash == MiMC(nullifier), leaf == MiMC(nullifier, trapdoor), the path from leaf hashes to root (MiMC(left, right) per level); context is bound only as a public input

srs.note: unsafekzg.WithToxicSeed: tau is derived from the seed, so anyone can forge proofs; test vectors only
srs.toxicSeed: verifier.cash plonk-kzg TEST SRS v1 (unsafe, toxic value is public)

notes.linOpening: ClaimedValues[0] of gnark's proof struct (opening of the linearised polynomial at zeta); not part of the 768-byte proof, the verifier recomputes it (verify.mjs cross-checks it equals r0)
notes.proofs: gnark's prover blinds with crypto/rand, so re-running gives different (equally valid) proofs
notes.tampered: expect is the reference verdict; gnark is gnark's own Verify on the same tampered struct, or n/a for byte-level encodings gnark's structs cannot hold
